en: A color postcard-style image of a mountain resort set in a lush alpine valley. Several multi‑story hotels line a road, with 'GRAND HOTEL PEJO' clearly visible on the central building. Surrounding the hotels are green meadows, scattered chalets, tall conifer trees, and high mountains with snow‑capped peaks in the background. Red printed text in Italian appears at the top of the postcard describing the location and its elevation.
